scope: Correct the five blocking themes in the Phase4 v2 seven-image independent TA review before any formal-68 capture is reconsidered.

blocking_themes: trajectory and table contrast remain too low beneath full-screen dark row/card panels
full-screen panel composition materially occludes gameplay and trajectory comparison
720/UI1.35/CVD and expanded comparison rows omit required Rails N text
Retina ReplayPlayback actual-only lacks the required Replay actual legend and the path is too faint
Advanced expanded omits first/last tick, preview budget outcome, and trace/content hash fields

global_rules: Remove every full-frame row background and every full-frame dim/scrim used by the training or replay inspector.
All inspector backgrounds, row backgrounds, separators, focus fills, and shadows must be clipped to one resolved bounded-inspector rectangle.
Select left or right docking after projecting the current predicted/actual path bounds; choose the side with no protected-corridor intersection and the greatest separation from the path.
If neither side can satisfy the protected corridor, use the compact overlay state and fail closed rather than covering or dimming the route.
The table outside the inspector retains production tone mapping; no inspector opacity is multiplied across the framebuffer.

protected_gameplay_corridor.construction: Union the projected cue-ball marker, first-contact corridor, predicted stroke/dashes/ring, actual stroke/ticks/filled endpoint, target ball and target pocket bounds, then dilate by 48 physical px.

physical_1920x1080_four_camera_bounded_i.machine_geometry_gate: Record the final inspector rectangle, every panel/background rectangle, protected-corridor mask, intersection area, continuous no-panel rectangle, and total panel area. Any bound violation is a hard FAIL.

physical_1280x720_ui135_cvd_reflow.layout: One bounded single-column inspector docked opposite the projected path; never use a three-column full-width card grid.
required_visible_order: Attempt / score plus exact success/failure reason
Replay status plus Replay ready/unavailable reason
Predicted full legend row including endpoint X/Z and Rails N
Replay actual full legend row including endpoint X/Z and Rails N
Preview trajectory or Retry shot primary action
physical_1280x720_ui135_cvd_reflow.secondary_information_policy: Objective and recommended-assist details may collapse to labelled one-line disclosures; required score/reason/replay/trajectory/rail content may not be hidden, elided, scrolled off the captured state, or replaced with icons.
physical_1280x720_ui135_cvd_reflow.cvd_rules: Standard and CVD states preserve identical text, dash/tick/endpoint topology, bounds and z-order; palette changes may not change semantic inventory.

contrast_and_luminance_safety_margin.sampling: For every rasterized centerline, dash, tick and endpoint sample, compare resolved stroke pixels against a 5x5 local rendered-background neighborhood excluding the stroke and halo; report p01, minimum, and failure coordinates.
contrast_and_luminance_safety_margin.halo_rule: Resolve a dark or light 2-3 physical px halo per profile so both semantic stroke and marker silhouette remain separable over cloth, rail, ball, walnut and panel edges.
contrast_and_luminance_safety_margin.manual_requirement: An independent reviewer must still follow each path end-to-end at original size, confirm both paths remain distinct in grayscale/CVD, and reject visually intermittent, muddy, or panel-suppressed segments even when sampled ratios pass.

required_fields_each: endpoint X/Z cm or Endpoint offscreen
predicted_and_actual_legend_rows.machine_gate: The draw list must contain one exact localized Rails N text run bound to each visible or hidden track row; N must equal the snapshot railCollisionEvents value.

replay_playback_actual_only.required_legend_swatch: cyan solid plus perpendicular ticks plus filled endpoint
replay_playback_actual_only.paused_truth_rule: A paused transport shows Play as the available action and enables fixed Step one tick; a playing transport shows Pause and disables fixed step. Screenshot state and transport snapshot must match.
replay_playback_actual_only.machine_gate: actual vertices > 0 implies exactly one Replay actual legend and zero Predicted legend/geometry in the actual-only state.

advanced_expanded.hash_abbreviation: Show at least the first 12 lowercase hexadecimal characters plus an ellipsis; accessibility value contains the full sha256:<64 lowercase hex>.
advanced_expanded.first_last_tick_rule: Both values are exact replay snapshot ticks; first <= last and neither is inferred from screen geometry.
advanced_expanded.budget_outcome_rule: Show the exact preview budget status and used/allowed sample or time budget supplied by the snapshot; do not use a generic Complete label.

per_capture_machine_hard_gates: actual GPU framebuffer PNG path, physical dimensions and sha256 are recorded
all predicted and actual physical stroke/dash/tick/endpoint values exactly match the profile
minimum local contrast >=4.0:1 and design-target coverage >=99 percent at 4.5:1 is reported with failure coordinates
predicted/actual local luma delta meets standard or CVD threshold
every required legend, Rails N, score, reason, replay status, actual-only legend or Advanced field exists for the state
authority before equals after and the existing performance gates remain unchanged
machine_negative_fixtures_required: reject a panel one pixel wider, taller, or larger in area than its profile maximum
reject any panel/protected-corridor intersection and any full-frame scrim alpha above zero
reject missing Rails N on either track at 720 or Advanced
reject actual-only geometry without Replay actual legend
reject each missing Advanced required field independently
reject contrast below 4.0, CVD luma delta below 36, or topology changed by palette
reject one clipped text run, safe-area violation, overlap, debug node, opaque icon, or unexpanded icon
independent_manual_axes: predicted amber dashed plus hollow ring is visible and recognizable without color
actual cyan solid plus perpendicular ticks plus filled endpoint is visible and recognizable without color
both routes can be followed end-to-end against table, balls, rails, walnut, panels and each other
bounded inspector leaves the declared continuous no-panel gameplay corridor and does not materially obscure the route
endpoint X/Z, Rails N, score, reason and replay-ready hierarchy is readable
720/UI1.35/CVD reflow is readable with no omitted required content
Retina ReplayPlayback actual-only state and Replay actual identity are truthful and readable
Advanced expanded contains every contracted field and remains collapsible
safe area, clipping, collisions, focus, and footer are visually sound
no debug or non-shipping presentation is visible
v3_seven_image_preflight_gate.manual_method: Review every PNG independently at original encoded dimensions. Machine contrast, zero-overlap and draw-list checks are supporting evidence only and cannot auto-fill a manual PASS.
v3_seven_image_preflight_gate.pass_rule: All seven machine cases PASS and an independent technical artist records zero blocking manual FAIL across all applicable axes.
v3_seven_image_preflight_gate.failure_rule: Any missing case, selector drift, SHA mismatch, machine failure, PENDING result or blocking manual FAIL keeps formal68 unauthorized.

implementation_order: replace full-frame row/scrim composition with the bounded-inspector resolver and protected-corridor mask
apply exact profile stroke/dash/tick/endpoint/halo values and raster contrast telemetry
make Rails N structurally mandatory in both track view models
add Replay actual legend to actual-only ReplayPlayback
complete Advanced first/last tick, budget outcome, authority and trace/content hash data
add fail-closed machine checks and negative fixtures
generate the v3 seven-image actual-GPU preflight, then request independent original-size manual review
must_not_do: do not modify or overwrite v2 manifest, manual review, PNGs, runner evidence or ready manifest
do not run or claim formal68 before the v3 seven-image machine and manual gate passes
do not infer readability from overlap_pairs=0 or machine contrast alone
do not claim M3 or external-human acceptance
